title: The Grunion Run, vii
logline: Seventh year. The first Grunion Run online. The chorus wants to know what a grunion is. Wood draws them one.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. GULLY's coffee line. WOOD with the pad. BARNABY in the surf. At the back of the panel, on the sand, four STICK FIGURES holding a sign: WHAT IS A GRUNION.

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns, a man pouring coffee for a line, another with a drawing pad, a dog in the surf, and four small stick figures at the back of the panel holding a crude sign, muddy watercolor and ink
image.notes: Sign: WHAT IS A GRUNION. Letter after.

panels.composition: Wood drawing one on the pad for them: a small silver fish, perfect, in three strokes.

image.prompt: close-up of a hand drawing a small silver fish in three confident strokes on a pad, lantern light

panels.composition: The stick figures looking at the drawing. Then at the actual surf, alive with them.

image.prompt: four small stick figures looking from a drawing pad toward a surf line flashing with hundreds of silver fish

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The lanterns. The stick figures, for once, not typing. Wood, pad closed.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel with silver fish under lanterns, a man with a closed pad, four stick figures standing still and watching, a dog, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm
